probe_comparison.finding: THE PROBE DRIFTS TOO, and by more than the executable does. Its own printed summary says so in words: `final forward speed 10.5647 (a sustained turn bleeds speed: 0092D300 rewrites only the axial component, so the lateral one stays)`. The probe builds the class hull body through 00937C90's tail; if the hull body were what resists lateral motion, this run would not drift.

probe_comparison.finding: The live Kortenaer and the probe on the same class and the same relative goal both drift and neither closes. The comparison's deltas are dominated by the probe starting from rest against the trace's seeded 12.0 m/s and by the two sides' different throttle sources; what it establishes is that the drift is a property of the shared composition, not of one side.

probe_comparison.case: the acceptance form, the one earlier published figure this milestone moves

That is the hull body's angular damping of 1.0f applied twice per substep, and it is the intended effect of this milestone's first change.
